definitions.gloss: leave of absence from school, academic leave
definitions.explanation: Temporarily suspending one's enrollment at a school or university, typically for personal, health, or financial reasons.

examples.japanese: {休学|きゅうがく}⟦{届|とどけ}→届け：07558_todoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To submit a leave of absence application.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{休学|きゅうがく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took a leave of absence from school due to illness.

examples.japanese: 1⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧{休学|きゅうがく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took a year off from school and studied abroad at a university overseas.

notes:
Temporarily suspending enrollment while maintaining student status. Common reasons include illness, financial hardship, family circumstances, or studying abroad.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休学|きゅうがく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take a leave of absence
- {休学|きゅうがく}⟦{届|とどけ}→届け：07558_todoke⟧: leave of absence application form
- {休学|きゅうがく}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: period of leave
- {休学|きゅうがく}⟦{中|ちゅう}→中：09840_chuu⟧: currently on leave

USAGE:
Unlike ⟦{退学|たいがく}→退学：03387_taigaku⟧ (withdrawal), {休学|きゅうがく} preserves the student's enrollment. The student can return via ⟦{復学|ふくがく}→復学：21607_fukugaku⟧. Most universities allow up to 2 years of leave.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{復学|ふくがく}→復学：21607_fukugaku⟧: returning to school after leave
- ⟦{退学|たいがく}→退学：03387_taigaku⟧: dropping out/withdrawal (permanent)
- ⟦{留年|りゅうねん}→留年：05141_ryuunen⟧: repeating a year
- ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧: enrollment
